scoring_justification: Binding energies and potential drops come from full DFT optimizations that cannot be re-run in the verifier; only the relative ordering (SnI2/A most negative binding energy, largest potential drop) is checkable.

outputs.description: Binding energies (Eb) for the four CH3NH3SnI3/TiO2 interface configurations. The scoring verifies that SnI2/A has the most negative value (strongest binding).
Electrostatic potential drops (ΔV) across each interface. The scoring verifies that SnI2/A has the largest value (best charge separation).

output_contract.notes: Scoring checks the relative ordering among the four interfaces: SnI2/A must show the most negative binding energy and the largest potential drop. Absolute values may vary due to code choice; the trends are the verified targets.

steps.description: Verify file exists and contains required JSON keys.
Verify all binding energies are negative and SnI2/A has the most negative value.
Verify file exists and contains required JSON keys.
Verify all potential drops are positive and SnI2/A has the largest value.
